shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log --oneline -3
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,200p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"validation|inputSchema|required|type\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md example/weather-tool.ts adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md CHANGELOG.md package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md
sed -n '1,520p' ../round-brief.md
sed -n '1,140p' package.json
sed -n '1,90p' example/weather-tool.ts
sed -n '112,150p' docs/adding-a-tool.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo NO_REANCHOR_SCRIPT; fi
rg -n "validated by:" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '15,110p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '8,28p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "test: cover tool input type rejection" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
